name: Growl
summary: Social deduction card game where humans pass wounds to hidden werewolves before three nights hit; bitten humans secretly become wolves.
rules_text: Setup a shared face-up deck containing Night cards seeded at 1/3, 2/3 and bottom of deck, plus Bite, Wound, Charm, Salve and Gold cards. Deal each player one starter Bite or Gold to secretly set Wolf Zeros; then deal 3 cards for a 4-card hand, redrawing if 3 wounds. On your turn draw the top deck card aloud: if it is a Night card resolve its effect then start Night Phase, otherwise you must give it to another living player who adds it to hand. Players die instantly when wounds minus salves reach 3, and humans secretly become werewolves when bites minus charms reach 3. During Night Phase no talking is allowed and each living player must pass one chosen card left and one right face-down, but humans may not pass Bites. After receiving, check death/turn. Game ends after Final Night is resolved or only two alive remain; if at least one human lives humans win, otherwise wolves win.
rating_reason: Social deduction hidden roles, bluffing, turn-based nights.
